title: Luna HVAC System V1
status: REFERENCE / CONCEPTUAL / SIMULATED — HVAC engineering strategy unresolved (DD12)

outOfScope.reason: Separate, disconnected common-area asset — MEP Coordination Spec itself flags it as 'a generic roof plant record... not proof of a whole-building HVAC strategy.' Deliberately NOT folded into this reference chain's resolver.

newCanonicalAssetsJustification: none created — every asset needed for the reference chain already existed from Phase 3C/13

topology.hvacConnection: LUNA-L06-APT-A-AC-OUTDOOR-01 <- connected_to <- LIVING-AC-01 / BED-01-AC-01 (refrigerant-connected, pre-existing edges, unchanged)
topology.electricalParentRef: each indoor unit's own parentRef is LUNA-L06-APT-A-AC-CIRCUIT-01 — a DIFFERENT relationship (power), never conflated with the HVAC connection

runtimeState.excludedStatesReason: nothing in the current canonical catalog legitimately models a distinct standby stage for these units
runtimeState.outdoorDemandDerivation: true whenever EITHER connected indoor unit is on && !fault — derived, never a second independently-invented notion of condenser activity

thermalSimulation.mechanism: recomputeHvacNetwork() in lunaSimulationProvider.ts, reusing the EXISTING 4-second ambient-tick interval — no second simulator created
thermalSimulation.coolingRule: room_temp_c steps toward target_temp_c when on && !fault, rate 0.16/tick
thermalSimulation.ambientRule: room_temp_c steps toward a 30C reference ambient baseline when off or faulted, rate 0.07/tick
thermalSimulation.jitter: small bounded random texture (+/-0.06C), never the dominant factor
thermalSimulation.sensorMirroring: LIVING-AC-01's room_temp_c is mirrored onto the real registered LIVING-TH-01 sensor every tick — one live truth, never two divergent readings
thermalSimulation.bedroomZone: no separate registered sensor exists — its room_temp_c lives only on the AC unit's own runtime state, disclosed as simulated-only, not a fabricated sensor asset
thermalSimulation.qualityLabel: quality: 'simulated' on every resolver output; every Oyi sentence includes the literal string '(reference simulation)'
thermalSimulation.faultBehavior: climateBehavior gained the same faultAware toggleBehavior guard the generator/pumps/ATS already use — a faulted unit refuses to start (state stays off), no user-facing resetFault exists

equipment: OutdoorCondenserGeometry — cabinet, top fan grille, side service panel, mounting frame/feet; fan spins only while demand=true
IndoorUnitGeometry — flat wall-mounted casing, front discharge louvre, top/rear intake strip; louvre glows while on, pulses while faulted
physicalGeometry.dispatch: HVAC_EQUIPMENT_KIND by-exact-ref table in OperationalAssetLayer.tsx, same pattern as Water/Electrical/Fire equipment

controlBoard.summaryWidget: HvacStatusSummary — reused headerContent? slot, dom hooks [data-hvac-status-summary]/[data-hvac-state]
controlBoard.hiddenAssetHandling: indoor-unit tabs render an honest boundary message for Facility ('Resident-managed comfort device. Not visible to Facility...') instead of a silently blank panel — see representationPolicy section below

oyiIntelligence.newMatcher: matchHvacStatus in lunaIntentParser.ts, inserted after matchFireStatus
newVocabulary: LUNA-L06-APT-A-AC-OUTDOOR-01 aliases (outdoor unit, outdoor condenser, the condenser, condensing unit)
LIVING-AC-01 gained 'turn on the ac' / 'is the ac running' / 'indoor unit' / 'the indoor unit' patterns

vocabularyBugFoundAndFixed.issue: an early draft's bare 'the ac' pattern was a substring of 'the active' (as in 'the active power path'), silently hijacking Electrical V1.1's own route phrase
vocabularyBugFoundAndFixed.confirmedVia: a real failure in verifyElectricalLiveOps.mjs, not a hypothetical
vocabularyBugFoundAndFixed.fix: replaced with the full literal phrases 'turn on the ac' / 'is the ac running', long enough to avoid the collision while matching the brief's exact required wording

oyiIntelligence.newServiceRouteEntry: UNIT_SYSTEM_TERMINATION.LUNA-L06-APT-A.hvac = LIVING-AC-01 — used ONLY for command-target resolution ('set Apartment 6A to 22 degrees'), deliberately NOT used for 'show hvac route' (see routeSimplification)

routeSimplification.reason: the reference chain's real connectivity is a connected_to edge, not a parentRef chain (each indoor unit's parentRef is its ELECTRICAL circuit) — walking that chain under an 'HVAC route' label would mislabel the electrical path as HVAC
routeSimplification.resolution: matchShowRoute's hvac branch navigates directly to the outdoor condenser instead of calling buildServiceRoute()
routeSimplification.precedent: same honest-anchor simplification as Electrical's 'active power path' and Fire's 'affected floor'

targetPhrasesVerified: What is the temperature in Apartment 6A?

representationPolicy.outdoorCondenser: CONTEXT_3D for Facility (already on FACILITY_OWNED_UNIT_ASSET_REFS allowlist — shared building plant, like the fire pump)

indoorUnits.priorDocumentation: lunaUnitMepAssets.ts's own pre-existing comment already states the resident's own indoor split units stay resident-only — this phase honored that decision rather than reversing it, and did not add the indoor units to the allowlist
indoorUnits.consequence: the HVAC Control Board's indoor-unit tabs are only ever meaningfully populated for Facility on the outdoor condenser tab; indoor-unit tabs show a disclosed privacy-boundary message for Facility, full state+controls for the assigned resident via the existing interior device-interaction surface (not this board)

safetyBoundaries: The outdoor condenser exposes zero commands — no independent start/stop authority was fabricated for it (Part 2/13's own instruction, already true in the existing schedule)
No condensate routing was fabricated — no canonical drain relationship exists for either indoor unit
No cooling capacity, refrigerant sizing, duct sizing, or manufacturer/model was fabricated
No new simulator, control architecture, or RepresentationPolicy change was introduced
